$comment: The native code in the iOS and Android apps that is not an npm package, for THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt (scripts/third-party-notices.mjs).
UPDATE THIS FILE WHEN NATIVE DEPENDENCIES CHANGE: a Capacitor plug-in added, removed or upgraded; ios/App/CapApp-SPM/Package.swift; android/app/build.gradle; android/variables.gradle.

The build fails when package.json installs a Capacitor plug-in that 'plugins' does not list, or 'plugins' lists one it no longer installs. It cannot see a plug-in's own Package.swift or build.gradle changing underneath it, so check those on every plug-in upgrade.
'plugins' maps each Capacitor plug-in (and the @capacitor/android and @capacitor/ios platforms) to the libraries it brings in; 'app' is what the app's own projects add.

A library either has 'licenceFile' (the upstream LICENSE, verbatim, under licences/), or 'copyright' and a licence whose standard text is in licences/texts/, or 'terms' (proprietary terms we link to and cannot reproduce). 'notice' is an upstream NOTICE file, which Apache-2.0 requires verbatim.
Versions are what the manifests ask for; Swift Package Manager and Gradle resolve the exact one at build time.
